No dark theme, no purple dashboard. Reuse same dock at x16 y27 width94 height653, 新境 triangular mint brand and labels 首页 / 游戏库 / 硬件 / 工具 / 优化 / 音乐, only 工具 mint selected. Same global search x208 y27 w423 h48 with 搜索游戏、工具或功能… and Ctrl K; avatar and shirt theme icon at top right, same minimize/maximize/close controls. Content starts x208, right edge1468, header y111 title 工具箱, subtitle 让游戏与日常，都更顺手。; date 2026年10月24日 星期六. Preserve wallpaper visibility around content. MiSans-like crisp Chinese sans, title36px, section22px, body14-16px, line icons in Font Awesome style, no emoji. Calm spacious purposeful UI, realistic readable Chinese, alignment and padding meticulous. One independent finished screen per image, no comparison, no device bezel or presentation labels, no option number in image. Use generous spacing, no clipped text, no chart/filler metrics. Direction named 轻盈工具台. Show tool discovery with a balanced dense-but-airy 3-column launch grid and small right rail. Top toolbar at y235: 搜索工具名称或功能… w440, category pills 全部工具 / 游戏辅助 / 网络与下载 / 系统维护, active 全部工具 mint. At right small 编辑收藏 action. Content y311: left main width~845, right width~395 separated20px. Main heading 常用工具 with small 我的收藏 inline action. Two rows of three compact 268x165 standalone tool cards for 下载加速 / 网络测速 / 辅助准心 / 屏幕测试 / 时间同步 / 录屏管理. Each glass card has a pastel mint or pale-blue icon tile top-left, small outline star top-right, bold name, single short description, bottom-right small 打开 arrow. Avoid huge illustrative thumbnails. Under grid lower at y730 a grouped 推荐与维护 area with two clean separated rows 运行库修复 (检测游戏所需运行组件) and 蓝屏日志 (查看崩溃记录与排查线索), each right chevron, no action performed. Right rail one glass surface 我的收藏 with 3 simple unboxed separated icon/name rows 网络测速 / 下载加速 / 屏幕测试 and footer 管理收藏. Below a modest pale glass 外部工具库 tile with package icon, description 浏览独立第三方工具 and 浏览工具 button; separate external-source badge 第三方. At bottom lightweight footnote 先查看详情，再按需使用。 Keep background lake visible below. Broad navigation and common tools dominate, only these two supporting right-rail areas.
